minutes.headline: Conservation Commission approved a garage at 932 Flat Hill Road, continued two lakeside rebuilds to Oct 4, and noted its administrator is leaving.
minutes.summary: The commission held two new hearings (38 Oak Ridge Road, 6 Peninsula Drive), both continued to October 4 for lack of a DEP file number. It voted to approve the 932 Flat Hill Road notice of intent, issue a certificate of compliance for 238 Fire Road 16, and handled extensions, enforcement matters and a pollinator plant purchase. The administrator announced she is moving and is not available for site visits.

what_happened.line: The Conservation Commission voted to approve a garage at 932 Flat Hill Road, but will hold the approval until an updated state wetlands form page arrives.
Hearings on 38 Oak Ridge Road and 6 Peninsula Drive were continued to October 4 for lack of a DEP file number, with the applicants given a list of items to supply.
The commission voted to require 10 Mass Ave to file a Request for Determination of Applicability and to formally close the town beach erosion enforcement.
A certificate of compliance was issued for 238 Fire Road 16, and an enforcement order for 39 Island Road is to be issued, allowing only stabilization work meanwhile.
The commission voted to spend from the Haas fund on a pollinator habitat plant order, and the administrator announced she is moving and cannot do site visits.

why_it_matters: Shoreline and wetland projects near lakes and streams need this commission's sign-off, and two lakeside rebuilds now wait on paperwork before they can move forward.
With the administrator leaving, the pace of site visits, permits and enforcement on residents' projects may depend on how quickly the position is filled.
watch_next: October 4 meeting: continued hearings for 38 Oak Ridge Road, 6 Peninsula Drive and 441 Townsend Harbor Road, and ratification of the 39 Island Road enforcement order.
